chunks: And from his will (peace be upon him), he used to write it to whoever he appointed over the charities.
ai.seo_question: What were the instructions for tax collectors in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This directive from Nahj al-Balagha highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) emphasis on transparency and accountability in fiscal administration, ensuring that tax collectors adhered strictly to divine guidelines rather than personal discretion. It reflects the Shia scholarly view of just governance, where the collection of zakat is treated as a sacred trust requiring precise documentation to prevent corruption and ensure equitable distribution among the eligible recipients.
